# People Atlas 0.12.2 — Alpha

> [!WARNING]
> People Atlas 0.12.2 is an alpha version of the plugin. Its fundamental
> behavior is subject to change in future releases.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.12.2 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
> Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

People Atlas 0.12.2 is the next alpha candidate after 0.12.1. It contains
readiness-safe indexing, canonical My Person selection safety, relationship
modal lifecycle hardening, localized diagnostics, and stabilized release/test
contracts.

> [!NOTE]
> Publishing People Atlas in the Community Plugins directory remains a separate
> step from this GitHub prerelease.

## Changes

- **Safer mobile indexing:** initial Markdown snapshots wait for reliable
  metadata resolution and do not publish partial people data. Premature
  readiness events, later creates, repeated resolution, and unload are handled
  without duplicate rebuilds or late lifecycle effects.
- **Safer My Person selection:** the picker keeps the current explicit-ID
  candidate set visible like relationship creation, while canonical path,
  uniqueness, stale-path, and ordinary-note checks reject invalid selections
  before `myPersonId` is written.
- **Relationship modal lifecycle hardening:** late submit and template-save
  callbacks cannot mutate closed modal or parent state.
- **Diagnostics and release contracts:** Dutch/English diagnostic presentation,
  fail-closed alpha/beta/RC/stable channel resolution, reproducibility, exact
  assets, and metadata checks are aligned.
- **Test-runner stability:** integration files and browser DPR instances run
  deterministically with fail-closed child-process handling.

## Breaking change / upgrade note

People Atlas 0.12.2 continues the fresh-vault-only boundary for the
presentation-first dossier layout. It does not migrate older folder layouts or
provide a backward-compatibility path for them.

## Assets

Install or update the plugin with the attached `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and
`styles.css`.
